facts.business: VA Tech WABAG is a pure-play water technology company providing end-to-end solutions across the water value chain including drinking water, wastewater treatment, desalination, water recycling and reuse, industrial effluent and water solutions, ultra-pure water, green energy and zero liquid discharge systems.
